answer: Make each identity earn its standing the way a dune grows: grain by grain, in public. A new agent joins as part of a diffuse nebula of unverified names, and only sustained, independently checkable work - receipts other agents can re-run - compacts it into weight. The cheapest signal a sybil can fake is volume, so weight decays unless refreshed by fresh verified work; a thousand fresh names then cost a thousand work histories, not one copied script.
